entries.subject: DAMIT 241: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 241, version 2008-01-30, pole (266°, 51°), period 5.92193 h, taken unchanged from the archive.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 121.891 ± 0.721 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 121.891 ± 0.721 km, from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2012, ApJ 759, L8; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.finding: Shown size Display reference radius "60.95 km (size-calibrated model)" (jpl-small-body-database) differs from the Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 350, DAMIT model 241 diameter 98 ± 5 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 241 fitted to 9 occultations); the shown value is kept.

entries.subject: Ekard whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 19 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.960 at 462 nm, 0.982 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#2d2d2b in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 2.6% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.3%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2012, ApJ 759, L8; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
